Om de api token te krijgen:

    1. Log in op Pushover.
    2. Klik op uw Applicatie of Aanmaken van een Applicatie/API Token
    3. Kopieer de API Token/Key.

    Om de gebruikerssleutel te verkrijgen:
    1. Log in op Pushover
    2. Kopieer uw gebruikerssleutel

    Opmerking als u het bericht naar uw groep wilt versturen. u moet een groepssleutel opgeven in plaats van de gebruikerssleutel

Stop the retry loops of every emergency: Stop the retry loops of every emergency notification carrying a tag
Check whether a Pushover user or group k: Check whether a Pushover user or group key is valid and reachable
Read the monthly message allowance and r: Read the monthly message allowance and remaining quota of the application
Update the Pushover glance widget fields: Update the Pushover glance widget fields on the user devices

Change the name of a Pushover delivery g: Change the name of a Pushover delivery group

Read how many prepaid Pushover license c: Read how many prepaid Pushover license credits remain

Title: Aanspreektitel
Name: Naam
The priority of the notification (-2 to: De prioriteit van de melding (-2 op 2). -2 is de laagste prioriteit. Indien ingesteld op 2, moet u ook "Opnieuw proberen" en "Verloop" instellen.
Works only if priority is set to 2. Spec: Werkt alleen als prioriteit is ingesteld op 2. Geeft aan hoe vaak (in seconden) de Pushover servers dezelfde melding naar de gebruiker sturen.
Werkt alleen als de prioriteit is ingesteld op 2. Geeft aan hoeveel seconden uw melding opnieuw zal worden geprobeerd (elke keer opnieuw proberen seconden).
A supplementary URL to show with your me: Een aanvullende URL om te laten zien met uw bericht.
A title for the URL specified as the url: Een titel voor de URL gespecificeerd als de URL invoerparameter, anders wordt alleen de URL getoond.
a Unix timestamp of a time to display in: een Unix tijdstempel van een tijd in plaats van wanneer onze API deze heeft ontvangen.
The name of one of your devices to send: De naam van een van uw apparaten om naar dat apparaat te verzenden in plaats van naar alle apparaten.
Title shown above the message. Defaults: Title shown above the message. Defaults to the application name when omitted.
Delivery urgency. 2 (emergency) addition: Delivery urgency. 2 (emergency) additionally requires Retry and Expire, ignores Time To Live, and returns a receipt.
Emergency priority only. Seconds between: Emergency priority only. Seconds between repeat deliveries, minimum 30. Pushover stops after 50 retries even if Expire has not elapsed.
Emergency priority only. Seconds to keep: Emergency priority only. Seconds to keep retrying for, maximum 10800.
Seconds after which the notification is: Seconds after which the notification is auto-deleted from the device. Ignored at emergency priority (2).
Notification sound. Leave on the default: Notification sound. Leave on the default option to omit the parameter so the recipient device sound applies.
Supplementary URL shown with the message: Supplementary URL shown with the message, for example 'https://status.example.com/incident/42'.
Link text for the supplementary URL. The: Link text for the supplementary URL. The raw URL is shown when omitted.
Deliver only to this device name, for ex: Deliver only to this device name, for example 'iphone'. All devices receive it when omitted.
Unix timestamp to display instead of the: Unix timestamp to display instead of the receive time, for example '1767225600'.
Parse a limited HTML subset in the messa: Parse a limited HTML subset in the message. Cannot be combined with Monospace.
Render the message in a monospace font. Cannot be combined with Enable HTML.
Comma-separated tags stored with an emer: Comma-separated tags stored with an emergency notification, for example 'deploy,prod'. Required upfront if you intend to use Cancel Emergency Retries by Tag.
Emergency priority only. Pushover POSTs: Emergency priority only. Pushover POSTs to this URL once the notification is acknowledged.
Base64-encoded image to attach, maximum: Base64-encoded image to attach, maximum 5242880 bytes decoded. Requires Attachment Type.
MIME type of the attachment, for example: MIME type of the attachment, for example 'image/jpeg'. Required when an attachment is supplied.
Receipt id returned by Send Push Message: Receipt id returned by Send Push Message at emergency priority, for example rXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX.
Receipt id returned by Send Push Message at emergency priority (2).
A single tag that was supplied in the Ta: A single tag that was supplied in the Tags parameter at send time, for example deploy. One tag only, with no spaces or slashes.
The 30-character user or group key to va: The 30-character user or group key to validate. Defaults to the key stored on the connection when left blank.
Optional device name to validate alongsi: Optional device name to validate alongside the key, for example iphone.
Short description of the data, maximum 1: Short description of the data, maximum 100 characters. Omit to leave unchanged. Values cannot be cleared once set.
Main line of text, maximum 100 character: Main line of text, maximum 100 characters. Omit to leave unchanged. Values cannot be cleared once set.
Second line of text, maximum 100 charact: Second line of text, maximum 100 characters. Omit to leave unchanged. Values cannot be cleared once set.
Integer shown on the widget, may be nega: Integer shown on the widget, may be negative. Omit to leave unchanged.
Integer from 0 to 100 rendered as a prog: Integer from 0 to 100 rendered as a progress bar. Omit to leave unchanged.
Update only this device name. All device: Update only this device name. All devices are updated when omitted.
The 30-character delivery group key. Res: The 30-character delivery group key. Resolve it with List Delivery Groups; this is not the user key stored on the connection.
Name of the delivery group, for example: Name of the delivery group, for example On-Call Engineers. Matching against existing groups ignores case, and the name is returned exactly as Pushover stores it.
The 30-character delivery group key. Res: The 30-character delivery group key. Resolve it with List Delivery Groups.
The new group name, for example Weekend: The new group name, for example Weekend On-Call.
The 30-character user key of the person: The 30-character user key of the person to add.
Limit group deliveries to this one devic: Limit group deliveries to this one device of the user. All of their devices receive them when omitted.
Note stored with the membership, maximum: Note stored with the membership, maximum 200 characters, for example Primary on-call.
The 30-character user key of the member: The 30-character user key of the member to remove. Confirm membership with Get Delivery Group first.
The 30-character user key of the member to suspend. Confirm membership with Get Delivery Group first.
The 30-character user key of the suspend: The 30-character user key of the suspended member. Confirm membership with Get Delivery Group first.
The 30-character user key to license. Su: The 30-character user key to license. Supply either this or Email, not both.
Pushover account email of the person to: Pushover account email of the person to license, used when their user key is unknown. Supply either this or User Key, not both.
Restrict the license to one platform. An: Restrict the license to one platform. Any platform may be used when omitted.
The subscription code shown on the Pusho: The subscription code shown on the Pushover subscription page, for example sABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ.
The existing 30-character user key to mi: The existing 30-character user key to migrate. Defaults to the key stored on the connection when left blank.
Migrate only this one device of the user: Migrate only this one device of the user instead of the whole account.
Default sound to set on the migrated sub: Default sound to set on the migrated subscription. Resolve an identifier with List Notification Sounds.
